svg.title: Golem tile mesh topology diagram
svg.desc: A representative three-by-three Golem mesh showing private QEMU tile endpoints, local Merlin link controls, five-port routers, north-east-south- west links, SST scheduling, and a highlighted Manhattan route from tile zero to tile eight.
svg.text: Golem mesh — private tiles connected by Merlin routers
Representative 3×3 expansion of the generic W×H builder · current ResNet deployment uses 8×8
advances every QEMU grant, receive-DMA channel, analog link, router, and physical mesh link
functional guest execution remains isolated inside one QEMU process per tile
